<figure class="reference-portrait"><a href="/images/charger-v016.webp"><img src="/images/charger-v016.webp" alt="Charger — staged in-game portrait" width="1600" height="900" /></a><figcaption>Actual game model, staged for this portrait in v0.16.0.</figcaption></figure>

An aggressive beast with a headbutt, a committed charge and a close-range stomp. Crowding or circling its flanks can trigger a 360-degree stomp with 12 knockback: leave the marked 3.2 m circle during the 1.05-second warning; it recovers for 1.4 seconds and has a 6-second stomp cooldown. Bait its charge into an obstacle to stun it.

## Health and poise

| Level | Variant | Easy / Builder health | Normal health | Hard / Hardcore health | Poise |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Charger | 115 | 126.5 | 149.5 | 65 |
| 2 | Charger | 166.75 | 183.43 | 216.78 | 65 |
| 3 | Elder Charger | 218.5 | 240.35 | 284.05 | 65 |

These are non-elite values before omens. Poise does not scale with creature level or difficulty. Creatures born in the outer lands are stronger by their land's danger tier (since v0.27.0): Birchwood and the coast **×1.35 health** and **×1.25 damage**, Elderwood and the Mire **×1.65** and **×1.45**, the Highlands and the Skerries **×1.9** and **×1.65**, with more poise, keener senses, a little more speed and elites more often; packs of Stalkers and spiders there hold one more. See [the lands' tiers](/biomes/). Base movement speed: **3.6 m/s**, before night, state, omen and elite modifiers.

## Attacks

| Attack | Base damage | Normal, level 1 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Headbutt | 16 | 17.92 |
| Charge | 24 | 26.88 |
| Stomp | 14 | 15.68 |

Damage = base × (1 + 0.3 × (level − 1)) × difficulty multiplier. Easy/Builder: ×1; Normal: ×1.12; Hard/Hardcore: ×1.35. This is outgoing hit damage before the hero’s armour, mitigation and other combat effects. Venom and grave rot are separate status effects.

## Damage types

| Kind of blow | Damage taken | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Crushing (clubs, fists) | ×0.7 | Resists |
| Cutting (blades, axes) | ×1 | Normal |
| Piercing (spears, arrows, picks) | ×1.5 | Weak |

A blow on a creature that has not noticed anyone is a **sneak attack**: ×3 damage, at most once every 5 minutes per creature. Exposed creatures take ×1.6 on top. See [Sneaking and damage types](/mechanics/#sneaking-and-damage-types).

## Elite and warden modifiers

Elite health is multiplied by 1.6, poise by 1.3 and outgoing damage by 1.15. Ironhide adds ×1.8 health and ×1.6 poise; Frenzied adds ×1.35 damage; Swift adds ×1.3 movement speed. Barrow wardens also apply their own health multiplier, ×1.6 poise and ×1.2 damage. These effects stack.

Elite loot is **additional** to the normal drops: one <a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/charger-trophy/"><img src="/images/icons/chargertrophy.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Charger Trophy</a>, two <a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/hide/"><img src="/images/icons/hide.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Raw Hide</a>, plus one <a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/crystal/"><img src="/images/icons/crystal.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Echo Crystal</a> with 65% / 80% / 95% chance at level 1 / 2 / 3. The game uses the Stalker trophy for elite spiders too. Omens can add further drops.
